items.note: Subagents always run in the background and return their child session ID immediately. The plugin now treats a task result carrying metadata.sessionID as a dispatch and records completion at the child idle.
A child idle whose own background work is still running is not terminal. The dispatch ledger waits until no background item is owned by the child, then finalizes on the next idle.
